=== Shift-Tab moves the item and its children to right after the parent
--- given
- a
  - b‸
    - c
  - d
--- when key Shift-Tab
--- then
- a
  - d
- b‸
  - c

=== Shift-Tab at the top level does nothing and swallows the key
--- given
- a‸
- b
--- when key Shift-Tab
--- then consumed
- a‸
- b

=== Shift-Tab keeps the moved item's fold
--- given
- a
  - b‸ ⊟
    - c
--- when key Shift-Tab
--- then
- a
- b‸ ⊟
  - c

=== Shift-Tab renumbers both ordered groups
--- given
1. a
   1. b
   2. c‸
   3. d
2. e
--- when key Shift-Tab
--- then
1. a
   1. b
   2. d
2. c‸
3. e

=== Shift-Tab in a tab list keeps the child one tab under the item
--- given unit=tab
- a
	- b‸
		- c
--- when key Shift-Tab
--- then
- a
- b‸
	- c

=== Shift-Tab keeps a selection inside the item on its characters
--- given
- a
  - ⟨bb⟩b
--- when key Shift-Tab
--- then
- a
- ⟨bb⟩b

=== Shift-Tab carries the notes lines one level out
--- given
- a
  - b‸
    a note
--- when key Shift-Tab
--- then
- a
- b‸
  a note

=== Shift-Tab passes to the editor when the Tab behaviour is switched off
--- given tab=off
- a
  - b‸
--- when key Shift-Tab
--- then passthrough
- a
  - b‸

=== The outdent command works without the Tab setting
--- given tab=off
- a
  - b‸
--- when command outdent
--- then
- a
- b‸
